meta.title: REV7 privileged inventory and staging closure
meta.author: root-manager

feature.problem_statement: The six-loop consolidation pipeline exhausted its review budget after independent review of exact head 0c18d6cc found four remaining gaps: final privileged directory metadata is not enforced, fresh-host admission staging is undocumented, the installed-root fixture masks service digest drift, and unrelated managed-prefix acceptance/race paths lack executable tests.
goals: Close all four independently verified REV7 findings without weakening the canonical authority contract.
Preserve the REV6 nonblocking FIFO defense, cleanup protocol, deauthorize-first lifecycle, and immutable evidence model.
Return one exact clean head to fresh independent review and root-capable validation.
non_goals: Host installation, runner-group policy mutation, workflow dispatch, PR merge, or any live authorization mutation.
Treating runner group 6 evidence as proof of runner group 7 readiness.
Changing terraform-plan-codicarium or broadening GitHub workflow authority.
scope_in: Exact directory uid/gid/mode/nlink enforcement and mutation tests.
Secure immutable admission staging documentation or a minimal safe helper with explicit --admission-root.
Contract-preserving installed-root service digest fixtures and agreement tests.
Executable allowUnrelated/managedPrefixes safe, unsafe, metadata, special-file, and stat-to-fstat race coverage.
Mechanical synchronization of authoritative manifests, contracts, documentation, and digests.
scope_out: Pushing, opening or merging a PR before fresh review/test/validation.
Host rollout or protected workflow authorization.

requirements.statement: Final inventory directories MUST match the canonical descriptor's exact uid, gid, mode, and link count and MUST fail closed on any type or metadata drift.
requirements.rationale: Writable or multiply linked privileged directories can invalidate the installed-root security boundary.

requirements.statement: Fresh-host documentation MUST define a root-owned immutable admission staging procedure and invoke installation with an explicit admission root, or the package MUST provide an equivalently safe minimal staging mechanism.
requirements.rationale: The documented default currently fails closed because a normal checkout lacks staged admission files and admission.manifest.

requirements.statement: Installed-root tests MUST preserve the contract-declared service SHA-256 and separately prove fixture bytes agree with the contract rather than overwriting the expected digest.
requirements.rationale: Self-derived fixture expectations cannot detect authoritative contract drift.

requirements.statement: Executable root-capable tests MUST cover allowed managed-prefix regular entries, unsafe types and metadata, and stat-to-fstat identity mutation returning inventory_unrelated_entry_raced.
requirements.rationale: Security-sensitive acceptance and race branches require behavioral rather than source-string evidence.

requirements.statement: The change MUST preserve all prior consolidation invariants, especially REV6 O_NONBLOCK source opens, three-line cleanup protocol, deauthorize-first lifecycle, group-7 evidence requirement, bounded parsing, and no live mutation.
requirements.rationale: Closing new gaps must not regress already reviewed privilege-boundary controls.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Given a synthetic installed root, when any declared privileged inventory directory has wrong owner, group, mode, link count, or type, then verification fails with a bounded deterministic reason before accepting inventory.

Given a fresh host and reviewed checkout, when an operator follows the documented staging and install sequence, then the exact immutable admission files and manifest are staged root-owned and install receives an explicit admission root.
Given installed-root fixtures, when the canonical contract service digest drifts from fixture bytes, then a dedicated agreement test fails and no fixture rewrites the contract expectation.

Given managed-prefix unrelated entries, when entries are safe, special, metadata-drifted, or changed between stat calls, then safe entries pass and each unsafe or raced case fails with its exact bounded reason.
Given the REV7 diff, when full contract, package, ownership, root-capable, workflow, syntax, and digest suites run, then all prior invariants still pass and no live-state action appears.

test_plan.approach: Mutate uid, gid, mode, nlink, and type for every declared inventory directory in generated roots and assert exact fail-closed reasons.
Mechanically validate documented staging commands, exact admission manifest inputs, root ownership/mode requirements, and explicit --admission-root invocation.
Keep contract digest immutable, compare it to fixture bytes, and inject digest drift to prove the agreement test fails.
Use a disposable root-capable environment to create allowed, special, metadata-mutated, and identity-raced managed-prefix entries and verify exact outcomes.
Run full consolidation suites, manifest checks, actionlint, Python/shell syntax, diff checks, and independent full-diff review; statically confirm no live mutation and group-7 gates remain.

review_checks: Review descriptor metadata comparison before directory acceptance.
Review root-owned immutable staging and explicit admission-root boundary.
validation_checks: Documentation/package contract guard and fresh-root staging test pass.

review_checks: Confirm fixture never mutates canonical service sha256.
validation_checks: Fixture-contract digest agreement and negative drift test pass.

review_checks: Review allowUnrelated/managedPrefixes identity and metadata checks.
Compare REV7 against REV6 invariants and delivery gates.
validation_checks: Full suites and independent review pass at exact clean head.

perspectives.summary: Exact privileged directory metadata and identity-race behavior are release-blocking authority-boundary requirements.
A fresh-host procedure must explicitly stage immutable root-owned admission inputs and cannot rely on an absent default path.
Fixtures must not rewrite authoritative expectations and all security-sensitive branches need executable root-capable tests.

council.consensus_summary: Proceed with a narrow REV7 code-only remediation, then repeat independent review/test/validation; keep host and GitHub authorization disabled.
